title: A4 Laurent exclusion with a regular long-map limit of rank at least106
statement: There is no complex formal Laurent degeneration A4 to M(10,10,11) with either long map regular and of rank at least106 at zero. The other maps may have arbitrary finite poles. The regular kernel residual bounds leading lifts of rank-one target matrices by19; the credited gap forces source rank16 or zero. Their coherent middle factor is fixed. A self-contained rank-one-preserver classification then gives an invertible matrix in the leading first-map kernel, contradicting the rank-at-most-two residual and the unit-image rank floor10.

title: Source rank gap bounds the normalized A4 long-map leading-rank sum by204
statement: After independently dividing each long map by its smallest entry valuation and compensating in the first map, any A4 to M(10,10,11) complex Laurent degeneration must satisfy r_B+r_C<=204. A larger sum forces the entire leading polar first-map image into the rank16 source locus, where every linear space has dimension at most4. Its kernel contains an invertible target parameter, contradicting the regular kernel residual on the larger long leg, whose unit image has rank at least7.
